grade_age: Grade 5 (age 10-11, upper end of our 9-10 target band)

deferred_reasons.2: Requires selecting among 4 rendered scatterplot images - visual-dependent, not restatable in text
deferred_reasons.5: Shape-sorting graphic organizer includes semicircle/crescent images that must be visually distinguished
deferred_reasons.11: Requires selecting among 4 shaded-grid area models (visual division representation)
deferred_reasons.14: Number line diagram with an unlabeled arrow segment - the specific fraction subtracted is only shown visually, not stated in text
deferred_reasons.15: Frequency table uses tally-mark images; exact counts not independently verifiable from text alone, risk of transcription error
deferred_reasons.18: Base layer block count is only shown in an image (rows of blocks), not stated numerically in text
deferred_reasons.24: Requires visually distinguishing tick-mark/angle-mark conventions on 4 triangle images to identify scalene
deferred_reasons.34: Requires measuring a rectangle diagram with an on-page ruler - fundamentally an image-measurement task

note: All 24 usable items are either pure text/table/expression problems, or diagrams whose numeric values are fully stated in the surrounding text (items 22, 27 - diagram shows labeled distances/lengths already given as text, no image-reading required to solve).
